key.name: output-directory
key.description: Directory where framed images are written. An empty value means "next to the source image" (same folder as each source file).

key.name: suffix
key.summary: File name suffix for framed images
key.description: Suffix inserted before the file extension of the output file name. Example: photo.jpg becomes photo_framed.jpg.

key.name: frame-percent
key.summary: White frame thickness as a percentage of each canvas edge
key.description: Thickness of the white frame on every side, as a percentage of the target canvas edge. Two decimal places, 0.00 (no frame) to 20.00.

key.name: aspect-preset
key.summary: Aspect ratio preset for the target canvas
key.description: One of the built-in aspect ratio presets (5:4, 19:16) or "custom", which uses the aspect-num / aspect-den keys.

key.name: aspect-num
key.description: Numerator A of the custom A:B aspect ratio. Used when aspect-preset is "custom".

key.name: aspect-den
key.description: Denominator B of the custom A:B aspect ratio. Used when aspect-preset is "custom".

key.name: orientation-portrait
key.summary: Flip the target canvas to portrait
key.description: When false the canvas uses the aspect ratio as entered (landscape bias); when true the ratio is flipped to portrait.

key.name: short-edge
key.summary: Short-edge resolution of the target canvas in pixels
key.description: The short edge of the output canvas in pixels. The long edge is derived from the aspect ratio (round-half-up), so the short edge is exactly this value.
